trigger: User identified mismatch between field HVAC count and gateway capacity and provided project reference rows for IRT-MED-Mod / IRT-Bus-Mod.

field_inventory.note: Outdoor units must not be counted as IRTrans bus modules unless the manufacturer topology explicitly requires/permits that.

current_project_reference.interpretation: One IRTrans Mediacontroller is a bus master and can control up to 15 additional IRTrans bus modules. This is an address/device limit on the serial bus, not 15 physical I/O ports.

manufacturer_findings.fact: One Mediacontroller can control up to 15 IRTrans Bus Modules; each bus module is uniquely addressable.
IRTrans modules with the bus can connect up to 15 additional bus modules to one bus master; the IRServer can address multiple buses.
TCONTCCMHCM04A + adapter is shown with capacity up to 23 indoor units in that U-Match application.
The protocol converter acts as a Modbus master and supports connection of 4 Modbus slave devices; exact HVAC system topology must be considered.
TCONTCNBACNET supports up to 192 indoor units and 24 refrigerant systems, with 24 Vac/dc supply, for the TVR Connect family.

engineering_conclusions: The previous single-gateway architecture is not acceptable for 32 indoor units when using IRT-MED-Mod with one bus module per indoor unit.
For the IRTrans architecture, use at least 3 Mediacontrollers and 32 IRT-Bus-Mod modules for 32 independently addressed indoor units.
The 6 condensers must be integrated according to the actual HVAC manufacturer's native topology; do not automatically allocate 6 additional IRTrans bus modules.
The R03 selection of one TCONTCCMHCM04A must be reopened because manufacturer evidence does not support 32 indoor units as a single direct solution in the referenced application.

Preferred redesign is a manufacturer-native Trane gateway sized for the exact supplied VRF family. If the system is TVR Connect, TCONTCNBACNET is a strong candidate because its documented capacity exceeds 32 indoor units and 6 refrigerant systems; exact unit family compatibility must be proven before freezing.

release_effect.final_gateway_freeze_requires: Exact HVAC indoor/outdoor model/family and official compatibility evidence.
